# Check Fluent action titles when dark-message preferences change externally

The current preference observer updates the negative checkbox state and schedules timeoutReload. Initialization and click handling also select the Fluent Enable/Disable action title, but the observer itself does not. timeoutReload calls ReloadMessage, which calls displayMessage for the message URI; it does not recreate the about:message document. Proposed scoped test: change mail.dark-reader.enabled outside this checkbox and check its state and action title after reload. This inspected path motivates a synchronization check, not a reproduced title or accessibility failure. The inverse checkbox and native focus contracts are already shared. Static source and test inspection only. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is pending.

Scope: Dark message checkbox state and title.
